title: Sample review · Foundation
summary: A controlled first pass for physical samples that keeps evidence, observations and revisions separate.
contentNotice: Demonstration learning content for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy, curriculum or language instruction and must be reviewed before operational use.

steps.title: Received condition
steps.text: Document packaging and any transit issue before altering the sample.

steps.title: Specification
steps.text: Compare measurable details with the version that was requested.

steps.title: Construction and material
steps.text: Record observations as facts before proposing revisions.

steps.title: Decision
steps.text: State whether the sample is approved, rejected or requires a new revision.

blocks.text: A later reviewer should be able to distinguish the sample that arrived, the observations made on it and the revision that was subsequently requested.
